description: Chart Layout Architecture Refactoring: Establish consistent sub-panel architecture with shared X-axis and proper indicator alignment. Address layout bugs where volume and RSI panels occlude each other.
principles: Rock-solid quality over speed - every feature must be bulletproof before moving on
Comprehensive test coverage - unit tests, integration tests, edge cases
All tests must pass before a story is marked complete
No story is done until it's documented and tested
Fail fast, fail loudly - errors should be obvious and actionable
Consistent architecture - establish patterns for future indicator additions
Apply learnings from AGENTS.md - no ANSI codes, use Rich markup, explicit heights

background.problemStatement: The current ChartPanel has an inconsistent architecture: volume bars are rendered as inline Labels within #chart-content while RSI is a separate IndicatorPanel widget. This causes layout conflicts where toggling RSI visibility occludes volume bars and X-axis labels.
currentState: Volume bars rendered inline as Labels in _render_chart()
RSI panel is a sibling widget to #chart-content container
X-axis rendered as part of price chart, not shared
Height calculations scattered across multiple methods
Toggle interactions cause visual occlusion bugs
desiredState: Clean separation: PriceSubPanel (with embedded volume) + IndicatorPanels + SharedXAxis
Single ChartContext dataclass shared by all sub-panels
X-axis rendered once at bottom, after all panels
Volume always visible (no toggle), tightly coupled with price
Perfect alignment between price chart and indicators

criticalLearningsFromAgentsMd: NEVER use ANSI escape codes for colors in Textual widgets - use Rich markup ([green]text[/green])
Label widgets need markup=True to render Rich markup colors
Textual CSS height: auto and 1fr can conflict - prefer explicit heights for predictable layout
Widget compose() defines structure, _render_content() updates dynamic content
Use container.remove_children() + mount() pattern for dynamic updates
architecturePrinciples: Single source of truth: ChartContext holds all shared data
Parent orchestrates: ChartPanel calculates heights, children render within bounds
Immutable data: ChartContext is frozen, passed by reference safely
Consistent interface: All indicators extend IndicatorPanel with same contract
